name: Hezrou
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the hezrou must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this hezrou's Stench for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hezrou makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

description: Hezrou are hulking, toad-like demon soldiers whose overpowering stench alone can wear down enemies before their crushing bite and claws finish the fight.
